cards.text: World War II: The liberation of Yugoslavia from Axis occupation continues. Bajina Bašta in western Serbia is among the liberated cities.
NASA launches Space Shuttle Discovery on STS-51.
Sirimavo Bandaranaike is sworn in as prime minister of Ceylon, becoming the world's first democratically elected female head of government.
The United Kingdom recognizes Bahrain's independence, which is commemorated annually as Bahrain's National Day.
The Holocaust: Schutzstaffel chief Heinrich Himmler orders that Roma candidates for extermination be deported to Auschwitz.
Tonkin Campaign: French forces capture the Sơn Tây citadel.
Norwegians vote to end the union with Sweden.
United Arab Emirates holds its first-ever elections.
Erden Eruç completes the first solo human-powered circumnavigation of the world.
SS Valencia runs aground on rocks on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, killing more than 130.
William Gray of Hartford, Connecticut is granted United States Patent Number 408,709 for "Coin-controlled apparatus for telephones."
The passenger steamer SS Columbia sinks after colliding with the steam schooner San Pedro off Shelter Cove, California, killing 88 people.
A performance of Wagner's Das Rheingold opens the first Ring cycle at the first Bayreuth Festival.
Norwegians vote to end the union with Sweden.
Inauguration of Leopold I of Belgium, first king of the Belgians.
The Convention of London, a treaty between the United Kingdom and the United Netherlands, is signed in London, England.
The Chicago Bears defeat the Portsmouth Spartans in the first NFL playoff game to win the NFL Championship.
The Holocaust: Schutzstaffel chief Heinrich Himmler orders that Roma candidates for extermination be deported to Auschwitz.
Bonanza, the first regularly scheduled TV program presented in color, is launched in the United States.
World War II: The liberation of Yugoslavia from Axis occupation continues. Bajina Bašta in western Serbia is among the liberated cities.
The Holocaust: Schutzstaffel chief Heinrich Himmler orders that Roma candidates for extermination be deported to Auschwitz.
The Nutcracker by Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky premiers in Saint Petersburg, Russia.
World War II: Australian and American forces defeat Japanese army and navy units in the bitterly fought Battle of Buna–Gona.
Second Anglo-Sikh War: The Siege of Multan ends after nine months when the last Sikh defenders of Multan, Punjab, surrender.
A magnitude 7.0 earthquakes strikes off the coast of Taiwan, triggering a tsunami and killing at least 580 people.
Third Taiwan Strait Crisis: The People's Liberation Army begins firing missiles into the waters north of Taiwan.
Hurricane Gilbert devastates Jamaica; it turns towards Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula two days later, causing an estimated $5 billion in damage.
World War II: The liberation of Yugoslavia from Axis occupation continues. Bajina Bašta in western Serbia is among the liberated cities.
Creation of the Central Intelligence Group, forerunner of the Central Intelligence Agency.
The Soviet Union launches a large rocket, Lunik II, at the Moon.
NS Savannah, the first nuclear-powered cargo-passenger ship, is launched as a showcase for Dwight D. Eisenhower's "Atoms for Peace" initiative.
World War II: Australian and American forces defeat Japanese army and navy units in the bitterly fought Battle of Buna–Gona.
Tonkin Campaign: French forces capture the Sơn Tây citadel.
World War I: Admiral Franz von Hipper commands a raid on Scarborough, Hartlepool and Whitby.
A Lockheed L-188 Electra crashes in Jamba, Cuando, Angola, killing 141 people.
Typhoon Maemi, the strongest recorded typhoon to strike South Korea, made landfall near Busan.
NASA launches into orbit the Terra platform carrying five Earth Observation instruments, including ASTER, CERES, MISR, MODIS and MOPITT.
World War II: The liberation of Yugoslavia from Axis occupation continues. Bajina Bašta in western Serbia is among the liberated cities.
NASA launches Space Shuttle Discovery on STS-51.
One hundred fifty-six Congolese Tutsi refugees are massacred at the Gatumba refugee camp in Burundi.
Sirimavo Bandaranaike is sworn in as prime minister of Ceylon, becoming the world's first democratically elected female head of government.
SS Valencia runs aground on rocks on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, killing more than 130.
The Haiyuan earthquake of 8.5Mw rocks the Gansu province in China, killing an estimated 200,000.
Israel–United Arab Emirates relations are formally established.
The Abundant Life Christian School shooting in Madison, Wisconsin, United States, takes place, resulting in the death of three people.
